sealed_statement.family: For every n>=7 there exists a P7-free exact source-valid post-M/post-Lemma10/seed-two state satisfying the frozen B0 hypotheses and containing one fixed B0 coarse class sigma whose survivor/component incidence graph I_sigma is the all-edge 1-subdivision of an elementary (n x n)-wall.
fixed_sigma: all wall survivors have the same exact 3-list {2,3,4}
same all-zero stored-Q support profile to {p,m,n0}
sealed_statement.hard_state: After seed-two + transferred Lemma10, a second surviving 3-list class r with list {1,3,4} still meets residual Y0, so axiom (vi) remains false.

P7_certificate.conclusion: full family is P7-free for arbitrary n

exact_consequence.statement: There is no function q(|S|) that upper-bounds the mim-width of I_sigma for every source-valid B0 coarse class sigma in the frozen domain; the family has fixed source seed/support pattern while mim-width tends to infinity.
exact_consequence.relation_to_A0: By COMMON_LAYER_MIM_UNION_EQUIVALENCE_V1, no universal common decomposition can have per-layer common width bounded by a function of seed size on this family.
exact_consequence.D1_status: The conditional n^{O(12w)} D1 counting theorem remains valid, but w cannot be universally bounded by q(|S|) via this common-mim route.

what_survives: Existing scoped APMA boundary carriers remain available on subclasses satisfying their exact preconditions.
A router may still isolate special source subclasses with bounded layout.
Non-mim interfaces or other source-specific compression mechanisms remain open.
The wall family itself may admit another polynomial repair not based on bounded common mim-width.
forbidden_retries: Do not attempt a universal theorem B0/B1A/full-quotient geometry => bounded mim-width(I_sigma).
Do not attempt to rescue that theorem merely from per-layer P7-freeness or a P7-free/2-colorable survivor completion.
Do not infer impossibility of all polynomial L2 repairs from this width obstruction.
